# Amit Verma — Portfolio & Machine Data

> Backend & Systems Engineer specialized in low-level TCP sockets, C++ in-memory caching, WebGL GPU rendering, and agentic systems.

## Primary Endpoints
- [JSON Data](https://amve.tech/data.json): Structured machine-readable profile, education, featured projects, and technical skills.
- [Website](https://amve.tech): Minimal, static zero-JS portfolio.

## Core Projects
- [Reddish](https://github.com/amitverma-cf/reddish): Single-threaded, non-blocking RESP/TCP in-memory database in C++23.
- [agent.cpp](https://github.com/amitverma-cf/agent.cpp): Ultra-low latency C/C++ AI agent library for edge devices.
- [pacs](https://github.com/amitverma-cf/pacs): Clinical-grade 3D DICOM volume renderer using WebGL and GPU ray-casting.
- [vector-agent](https://github.com/amitverma-cf/vector-agent): Multi-agent SVG generation system in Python with VLM critique loop.
- [movie-rag](https://github.com/amitverma-cf/movie-rag): Conversational movie search over ~12k TMDB films combining FAISS and SQL tool-calling.
